title: VendorQuotationExtraction
description: Structured fields extracted verbatim from a vendor's quotation document (PDF, scanned image, or a spreadsheet that isn't our own pricing-sheet template) by the vision-language extraction step. This schema is a pure data-extraction contract: it has no field that identifies a BOQ line item, names an action, or changes any record's status -- matching a returned row to a BOQ line item is a separate, deterministic step (app/procurement/quotation_matching.py), never something the model decides. Every extracted value is 'proposed' and requires human review before use (see app/services/quotation_ingestion.py).

currency.description: The 3-letter currency code the quotation is priced in, if stated or unambiguously inferable (e.g. a visible 'AED' or a dirham symbol). Null if not determinable.

vat_inclusive.description: true if the document states prices include VAT, false if it states prices exclude VAT, null if this is not stated anywhere in the document. Never guess -- null means unknown, not false.

line_items.description: One entry per priced line item found in the document, in the order they appear.

vendor_item_text.description: The item number/code exactly as printed next to this line, if any. Null if the document has no item numbering.

vendor_description_text.description: The item description exactly as printed, verbatim.

unit_price.description: The unit rate for this line, if stated. Null if not stated or not legible -- never 0.

quantity.description: The quantity for this line, if stated. Null if not stated.

extended_price_stated.description: The line total (unit_price * quantity) if the vendor printed one explicitly. Null if not shown -- do not compute it yourself.

remarks_text.description: Any remark, note, or qualification printed against this specific line. Null if none.

exclusions.description: Document-wide exclusions, qualifications, or scope carve-outs found anywhere in the text (e.g. 'excludes dewatering', 'testing by others') -- not necessarily tied to one line item.

flag_text.description: A short paraphrase of the exclusion, e.g. 'Excludes dewatering'.

source_quote_text.description: The exact sentence or phrase from the document this was found in -- a verbatim citation, never paraphrased or invented.

confidence.description: The model's own confidence in the overall extraction quality across all fields, from 0 (no reliable fields extracted) to 1 (all fields extracted with high certainty).
